facts.business: BIL Vyapar Limited (formerly Binani Industries Limited) is a company under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) with no plant locations, indicating it may be a holding or investment company with historical corporate guarantees to erstwhile subsidiaries.

auditor.name: TLB & Co.
